name: Warren McFarlane
mentions: …ven Hashknife cowboys who have just come through from Texas with 3,000 cattle, under the foremanship of W. D. McFarlane, started home from here yesterday morning. The through cattle are in splendid condition and have been turned out on the Little Missouri Hashknife range.

…Harmon, Mandan; A W Murphy, M H Murphy, Wyoming; E S Newman, Miles City; Frank Murphy, Hashknife camp; Warren McFarlane, D H McMairy, Texas; J E Gorman; C VanEeghan, Holland; H B Erebank, D Andre, S Andre, Hashknife camp; D S Elliot, G Kessler, New York; H H Harmon, Mandan.
